instruction_text: Speak directly to one listener with warmth and a smile in your voice; calm, steady and reassuring, like a favorite morning radio host, while keeping the news clear and credible.
asr_text: What if a literary prize had a rule like this for entry? Not you may use AI, but you must write with AI. Wait, is that really required? I thought AI was a helper, working behind the scenes. Now it is openly the ticket to enter. The Prix Pascal was announced in France. It is for French stories that have not been published, written by a person and AI together. Using AI is not an extra benefit or a special case. If you have not used it, you cannot apply. It may be too soon to say, at last we can compete to see how well AI can write. What I want to know is not about the writers. It is about the people giving the prize. Why did they create a prize with this special rule for entry?
